what: Plan-mode tagged split does not reconcile with the existing validate-then-move merge pipeline
scenario_or_breakage: aggregate-findings.sh validates the raw LLM candidate against the full FINDINGS_FILE (input reviewers must all appear in candidate) before mv to findings-in-scope.md; excluding tagged blocks from the LLM prompt but leaving validate_py unchanged will fail whenever a tagged block is the sole finding for a reviewer slot, forcing AGGREGATED=false fallback and dropping the intended conservative-merge path
suggested_fix: In plan mode, build the LLM prompt from untagged blocks only, append tagged blocks after a successful untagged merge, and run marker/reviewer validation on the combined output (or validate untagged-only input against the LLM candidate plus a separate tagged-preservation gate)

what: Post-dedup parity fallback has no staged pre-dedup in-scope artifact
scenario_or_breakage: The loop only materializes _findings_tmp then deduped findings.md then split findings-in-scope.md; parity failure cannot fall back to a pre-dedup in-scope stream without first persisting a pre-dedup split (or re-splitting _findings_tmp) and wiring that path to skip or replace post-dedup findings-in-scope.md before aggregation
suggested_fix: Before the Jaccard deduper runs, split _findings_tmp into findings-in-scope.pre-dedup.md (and OOS if needed), run dedup/parity against that snapshot, and on parity failure copy the pre-dedup in-scope file to findings-in-scope.md before aggregation

what: Production /design marker shape is the inline TSV emitter not collect-findings.sh
scenario_or_breakage: /design converts reviewer TSV via embedded Python into separate **Severity** plus **Concern** lines (Concern carries raw what text), while collect-findings.sh folds severity into the Concern body as [important] what; detector tests that only exercise collect-findings.sh miss the live Concern format and can pass while production markers fail after dedup/aggregation
suggested_fix: Add test-plan-review-loop or test-check-scope-reduction-marker fixtures that use the inline emitter shape (- **Severity**: important / - **Concern**: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] ...) and assert detection after collect, dedup, and plan-mode aggregation

what: Dedup merge order can drop a leading marker before parity runs
scenario_or_breakage: Current dedup keeps the first Jaccard match and merge_reviewers(kb, blk) discards the later body; an untagged block that appears before a tagged duplicate will lose [SCOPE-REDUCTION] until parity fallback fires, adding an extra degraded ballot path and relying on parity heuristics rather than deterministic tagged-wins merge
suggested_fix: Implement the planned tagged-wins rule inside the dedup loop (prefer tagged body or reinsert leading marker before parity) so tagged markers survive the primary path without depending on fallback
